answer.title: Automate CRM Lead Creation from Quote Request Emails
answer.trigger: When a new quote request email is received in email.
steps: Extract customer details and project description using AI.
Create a new lead in crm with the extracted details.
Send a confirmation notification to Claire.
answer.ai_help: Extracting customer name, contact details, and project type from the email body.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, an incorrect lead is created in the CRM which Claire can easily edit or delete.
